description: Create a fully formatted Microsoft Word document using AI-generated structured content. Supports headings, paragraphs, bullet lists, tables, and proper document styling.

topic.description: What the document should be about (e.g. 'project proposal for AI startup')

title.description: Document title. Auto-generated from topic if not provided.

instructions.description: Additional formatting or content instructions from the user

filename.description: Where to save the file. Defaults to Desktop with a sanitized title.

example_commands: create a Word doc about machine learning
make a report on quarterly sales in Word
write a project proposal in MS Word
create a formal letter in Word to the manager
make a Word document with a comparison table of programming languages
